value.name: Rosa admits Asha into the house
value.description: Rosa opens the door for Asha and grants her entry with quiet authority.
evidence: "Ms. Patel," Rosa said. It was not a question. "Come in. They are in the dining room. I made coffee."
"Thank you." Asha stepped into the vestibule.
She held the door with the unhurried authority of someone who had decided, long before this morning, who was allowed past her.

value.name: Asha arrives early for the meeting
value.description: Rosa notes that Asha has arrived eight minutes early, establishing the tense timing of the visit.

value.name: Rosa warns Asha about the man waiting inside
value.description: Rosa tells Asha that a man has been waiting since dawn and will accuse her of being late.
evidence: "He will say you are late." Rosa's mouth did not move toward a smile, but something in the corner of her eye did.
"He has been here since seven. Walking the rooms. Counting."

value.name: Asha questions what he is counting
value.description: Asha asks what the man is counting, prompting Rosa to imply he is tallying what he believes he deserves.

value.name: Rosa leads Asha toward the dining room
value.description: Rosa walks down the hall and Asha follows her deeper into the house toward the waiting group.
evidence: Rosa turned and started down the hall, and Asha followed her past a staircase whose banister had been polished so many times the mahogany looked liquid.

value.name: Rosa reveals she witnessed the will signing
value.description: Before they sit down, Rosa tells Asha she witnessed the señora's will four years ago and another change eight months ago.
evidence: "I will tell you something now, before you sit down, because once you sit down they will not let me speak. I was a witness for the señora when she signed her will, four years ago. I was a witness again, eight months ago, when she signed something else. A change."
value.time_hint: four years ago; eight months ago
